caribbean-2009.notes: Source 3 is a Baekjoon category for the whole Latin America 2009 regional set (13 problems incl. PA, PB), not only the Caribbean finals; problem E is not in the catalogue's list of 10 letters, and the title match is for the other letters. Confidence medium.

sources.evidence: A blog page titled Resultados 2009 with a table of 33 team rows (position, team, institution, country, ACs, time) plus institution and country tables.
A Baekjoon Online Judge category titled Latin America Regional Contests 2009 listing problems A to K, whose English titles match the known list except E, which shows a Korean title.

caribbean-2014.notes: Source 1: banner says 2014 but body pages (lodging nights in November 2011, results 2009 and 2010) are of earlier editions; confirmed on the banner only. Source 5: Baekjoon category page with all problem slots blank and deleted.

sources.evidence: The banner on the pages reads 'Sexta edición el 7 y 8 de noviembre de 2014', but the lodging page gives nights in November 2011 and the results pages are of 2009 and 2010.

The category page 'Latin America Regional Contests 2014' lists 14 slots (A to K and PA to PC) with empty titles, each marked deleted (삭제) with 0 submissions, so no problem content is shown.
